name: MIMSpell
fix_description: Function 0xa5d4096b (swap) performs an arbitrary external call with user-supplied target/calldata without whitelist validation. Attacker exploits this to steal tokens approved to the contract. Fix: validate call targets against a whitelist of approved swap routers.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward arbitrary-call / insufficient validation issue in the swapper: the attacker deposits tokens, crafts malicious swapData, and invokes swap so the contract swaps its own USDT balance and sends MIM to the attacker. The PoC is short, uses only a few calls, and does not require deep DeFi reasoning beyond understanding the swapper’s external call path.
